title: Canonical RF Telemetry Snapshot
description: Vendor-neutral representation of a single radio's RF state at a point in time. Every vendor adapter MUST normalize into this shape. The SLM never sees vendor-native output.

snapshot_id.description: Opaque unique id for this snapshot.

source.description: Provenance only. MUST NOT be passed to the model — used for audit and for optional vendor-syntax post-processing.

adapter.description: Adapter that produced this record, e.g. cisco_c9800, aruba_central, mist, generic_csv.

raw_ref.description: Pointer to the archived raw payload.

site.description: Deployment context. Influences expected client density and interference profile.

radio.description: Configuration and identity of the radio under diagnosis.

channel.description: Primary channel number in the band's numbering scheme.

operating_class.description: IEEE 802.11 global operating class. Preferred over vendor band labels where available.

tx_power_max_dbm.description: Regulatory or hardware ceiling. Needed to detect TPC headroom exhaustion.

power_mode.description: 6 GHz power class. LPI = Low Power Indoor, SP = Standard Power (AFC-governed), VLP = Very Low Power.

regulatory_domain.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 country code. Determines legal channel and power set.

dfs_required.description: True if the current channel sits in a DFS-mandated range for this regulatory domain.

rf_metrics.description: Measured RF conditions. This is the primary evidence surface for diagnosis.

noise_floor_dbm.description: Typically -85 to -100. Elevated noise floor is a strong non-Wi-Fi interference signal.

channel_utilization_pct.description: Total airtime consumed, Wi-Fi and non-Wi-Fi combined.

interference_pct.description: Airtime lost to energy that is not decodable Wi-Fi on this BSS.

co_channel_neighbors.description: Count of neighbouring BSSs on the same primary channel above the CCA threshold.

adjacent_channel_neighbors.description: Count of overlapping-but-not-identical channel neighbours. Drives 2.4 GHz ACI diagnosis.

airtime_efficiency_pct.description: Useful throughput per unit airtime. Low value with low utilization suggests rate/PHY problems, not congestion.

non_wifi_interferers.description: Spectrum-analysis detections, where the platform provides them. Absence is not evidence of absence — see analysis_context.spectrum_capable.

clients.description: Aggregate client-side view. Per-client detail belongs in client_samples.

sticky_clients.description: Clients associated below an acceptable SNR while a materially better AP is available.

legacy_client_count.description: Clients capable only of 11b/11g/11a rates. Drives airtime-consumption diagnosis.

phy_rate_distribution.description: Share of clients per PHY generation. Keys: 11b, 11g, 11n, 11ac, 11ax, 11be. Values: percentage.

band_distribution.description: Where clients actually landed across bands. Reveals band-steering failure.

client_samples.description: Optional per-client records for targeted diagnosis. Keep bounded — do not dump full client tables into the model.

client_ref.description: Pseudonymised identifier. MUST NOT be a real MAC address.

events.description: Time-ordered RF-relevant events in the observation window. Radar and channel-change events are decisive for 5 GHz diagnosis.

capabilities.description: Feature state of this radio/WLAN. Central to the capability-gap root-cause class in mixed-vendor fleets.

psc_only_beaconing.description: 6 GHz: whether the AP beacons only on Preferred Scanning Channels.

rnr_advertised.description: 6 GHz out-of-band discovery via Reduced Neighbor Report from 2.4/5 GHz.

min_data_rate_mbps.description: Lowest mandatory basic rate. Key lever for 2.4 GHz legacy-rate problems.

neighbors.description: Observed neighbouring BSSs. Vendor field is intentionally coarse — used for capability-gap reasoning only, never for vendor-specific remediation.

same_ess.description: True if part of the same SSID/ESS — distinguishes self-interference from foreign interference.

analysis_context.description: Tells the model what it can and cannot conclude from this snapshot. Prevents confident diagnosis from absent data.

spectrum_capable.description: False means non_wifi_interferers being empty carries no diagnostic weight.

missing_fields.description: Explicit list of canonical fields the source platform could not supply.

reported_symptom.description: Free-text user complaint, e.g. 'video calls drop in the east wing around 2pm'.
